title: Colorimetric Analysis of Alkaline Phosphatase Activity in S. aureus Biofilm
protocol: Prepare 1 L of Tryptic Soy Broth (TSB) by adding 15 g of pancreatic digest of casein, 5 g of papaic digest of soybean meal, 3 g of sodium chloride, 2.5 g of dextrose, and 2.5 g of dipotassium phosphate to 1 L of distilled water.
Sterilize TSB before use.
Prepare Tryptic Soy Agar (TSA) by adding 15 g of agar to 1 L of TSB.
Autoclave TSA.
Allow TSA to cool down to room temperature.
Pour 20 mL of cooled TSA into Petri dishes (100 mm x 15 mm).
Sterilize 1 L of autoclaved TSB by adding 10 g of glucose and filtering through a 0.2 μm filter.
Inoculate one individual colony of S. aureus from TSA in 10 mL of TSB and grow overnight at 37 °C.
Dilute the overnight culture into 10 mL of TSB/glucose (10 g/L) at a ratio of 1:100 (v/v).
Vortex gently to ensure consistent concentration.
Transfer 200 μL of diluted culture into each of 18 wells in a 96 well plate, using triplets for each time point: 0 min, 15 min, 30 min, 45 min, 60 min, and 75 min.
Incubate the 96 well plate at 37 °C for 24 h to allow biofilm formation.
Decant the supernatant by aspiration after incubation.
Wash each well with 1x phosphate buffered saline (PBS) at pH 7.4.
Centrifuge plates for 5 min at 15,000 x g.
Decant the supernatant by aspiration after centrifugation.
Add 75 μL of buffered ALP substrate to each well from step 2.6 and begin recording the time.
Record each time point in triplicate.
Incubate for 0 min (control), 15 min, 30 min, 45 min, 60 min, and 75 min respectively.
Add 75 µL of 5 M NaOH to stop the reaction at each time point.
Centrifuge the plate for 5 min at 15,000 x g after stopping the reaction.
Transfer 100 μL of supernatant into a new 96 well plate for colorimetric measurement.
Measure the absorbance of each well at 405 nm using a 96 well plate reader.
Use the 0 min time point wells to control for 405 nm background noise.
Repeat the entire experiment in three individual 96 well plates.
